home_footer_description: Software, photo and video for clients across Europe, with dedicated teams for each field.
home_welcome_description: {headline} for businesses and people across Europe. Dedicated teams for each field, the same care for every project.
home_welcome_illustration: The Vest Visuals team working at a whiteboard with the Vest Visuals logo
home_divisions_description: Each field has its own team, with people who specialise in exactly what they do. Pick what you need.
home_media_tile_alt: Event photo taken by Vest Visuals
home_media_tile_description: Weddings, christenings, 18th birthdays, portraits, real estate, automotive and brand content.
home_software_tile_description: Web and mobile apps, custom software, cloud, data and automation.
home_about_description: Vest Visuals started in Timișoara with several fields at once and works with clients from Romania and across Europe. Whatever the project, we treat it the same way: we first understand what you need, work carefully and stay with you after delivery.
home_contact_description: Tell us what you have in mind and we'll put you in touch with the right team. We usually reply within one business day.
software_service_web_apps_description: From landing pages and online stores to complex web platforms. Clean, responsive design, and SEO done right from day one.
software_service_mobile_apps_description: iOS and Android apps people actually enjoy using. Intuitive, fast and polished down to the details.
software_service_custom_software_descrip: Desktop apps, internal tools and integrations between the systems you already use, built around exactly how you work.
software_service_cloud_devops_descriptio: We migrate, scale or optimise your infrastructure. Hassle-free deployments and systems that stay reliable as you grow.
software_service_data_engineering_descri: Collection from any source, ETL, databases and data warehousing. We build and run the whole pipeline, however big the data gets.
software_service_business_intelligence_d: Dashboards and reports that answer real questions about your business, not just numbers on a chart.
software_service_process_automation_desc: We analyse your workflows and automate the repetitive parts: emails, reports, whole processes and pipelines that run on their own.
software_service_technical_consulting_de: When you need a plan more than extra hands. We help with architecture, your existing codebase and decisions about what's worth building.
software_service_support_maintenance_des: We keep your systems fast, secure and up to date, so what we build together keeps running well for years after launch.
software_services_description: Every service, from apps to cloud and data, is done by people with experience in exactly that field. That's how we keep quality high across very different kinds of work.
software_footer_description: Custom software, cloud, data and automation, built for the way your business works.
software_hero_description: We build apps shaped around the way your business works. We understand the problem first, then write code, and we stay with you after launch.
software_portfolio_description: Real projects for real clients. Each one built from scratch, to fit the problem it solves.
software_project_aerionic: Aerionic connects a site's cameras, sensors and alarms to autonomous drones and response teams, so every alarm is checked within seconds.
software_cta_description: Describe your project, we'll look into it and get back to you as soon as we can, usually within one business day.
software_service_features_title: What you get when you work with us
software_service_technologies_descriptio: We pick what fits the project, not what's trendy.
media_hero_title: The moments that {#chart}matter,{/chart}{#br/}captured the way they {#success}should be.{/success}
media_hero_description: Weddings, events, portraits, automotive, real estate and brand content, shot and edited by a studio that genuinely cares about the result. Wherever your story happens, we're there for it.
media_about_description: We started Vest Visuals because we love what we do and we're picky about how it turns out. From the first message to the final gallery, you talk to the people actually behind the camera and the edit. We only take on projects we can give our full attention to, so your shoot never feels rushed or ordinary.
media_portfolio_description: A few recent projects we're proud of. Quality over quantity, every time.
media_portfolio_event_description: A night you won't forget anytime soon
media_portfolio_automotive_description: Cars that look like they're in an ad
media_editing_description: Good editing is the part nobody talks about but everybody notices. Drag the slider and watch a raw frame become the final image: it's all in the colour, contrast and mood.
media_locations_description: A good project is worth the trip. We pack our gear and come wherever you need us, near or far.
media_locations_elsewhere_description: We travel all over the country for the right shoot
media_cta_description: Send us a few details about what you need and you'll hear back within one business day.
media_service_packages_description: Prices are indicative. Every client gets a personalised offer, based on the length, location and what you need.
media_location_other_description: Tell us what you need and we'll find a way.
media_location_spots_description: A few places we recommend for photo sessions and event shots. It's not a closed list: we'll come anywhere you have a favourite spot.
media_location_free_travel_description: For {city} we don't charge anything extra for the trip. The price in the offer is the final price.
media_location_paid_travel_description: We travel from Timișoara, so for {city} we add the cost of travel and, if needed, accommodation. We discuss it openly, from the start.
media_location_book_early_description: For weddings and big events, we recommend writing to us at least 3-6 months ahead. Photo sessions can usually be scheduled within a few weeks.
media_location_elsewhere_description: We travel all over the country for the right project.
media_location_cta_description: Tell us the date, the place and what you need, and we'll send you a personalised offer within one business day.
account_welcome_description: This is where you'll find your albums, settings and everything about working with us.
admin_welcome_description: This is where you manage users, assets, the portfolio, albums and projects.
admin_users_description: Everyone who has created an account.
admin_assets_description: Images used on the site, outside the portfolio.
admin_portfolio_categories_description: The portfolio's categories and the groups in each one.
admin_portfolio_groups_description: Sets of photos from the same event or session.
admin_portfolio_media_description: Every photo and video in the portfolio.
account_albums_description: The photos and videos from your events.
account_settings_description: Your account details, security and preferences.
account_settings_two_factor_description: When you sign in, you also get a code by email.
admin_users_add_description: The account is created right away, and the user gets an email with a link to choose a password.
admin_users_name_hint: Optional. Otherwise, the part of the email before the @.
admin_users_created: {email} was added and got a link to choose a password.
admin_users_role_own: You can't change your own role.
admin_users_password_sent: We sent {email} a link to choose a password.
admin_users_delete_description: The account of {email} and all its data are deleted for good.
admin_portfolio_add_group_description: A group holds the photos from one event or session.
admin_albums_add_description: The client sees the album in their account, matched by email address.
album_share_description: Anyone with the link can see the album.
account_settings_email_description: The change is confirmed first from your current address, then from the new one.
account_settings_delete_hint: Your account and all its data are deleted for good.
account_settings_avatar_invalid: Pick a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo of up to 10 MB.
account_settings_avatar_failed: The photo couldn't be saved. Try again.
account_settings_email_sent: To change your email, open the link we sent to {email}.
account_settings_password_description: Needed to change your password or two-step verification.
account_settings_delete_confirm: We'll send you a link by email. Your account is deleted only after you open it.
account_settings_delete_sent: We sent you a link by email. Open it to delete your account.
admin_portfolio_category_contents: The category's groups, in the order they show on the site.
admin_portfolio_group_contents: The group's photos and videos, in the order they show on the site.
admin_assets_upload_description: If the key already has an image, it's replaced. The image is processed in the background once it's uploaded.
admin_assets_key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, as in the code. One that isn't in the code yet can be uploaded anyway.
admin_assets_file_hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, of any size.
admin_assets_uploaded: {key} was uploaded and is being processed in the background; the table shows when it's ready.
admin_assets_delete_description: Every size of {key} is deleted. Pages using it show no image until you upload it again.
admin_upload_failed: The upload didn't work. Try again.
admin_assets_variants_hint: The original is always kept; the chosen sizes are made from it.
admin_assets_variants_change_description: The chosen sizes are made again from the original, and the others are deleted.
admin_assets_variants_changing: {key} is being reprocessed in the background; the table shows its new variants when it's done.
admin_portfolio_add_media_description: Upload new photos, pick from those already in the portfolio, or add a YouTube video. Everything is added at the end of the group.
admin_portfolio_category_key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, in English; it's in the link: /portfolio/key.
admin_portfolio_category_not_empty: The category has groups that aren't in any other category. Move or delete them first.
admin_portfolio_delete_category_descript: Only the {key} category is deleted; its groups stay in the other categories.
admin_portfolio_delete_group_description: The group disappears from every category. Its photos are deleted with their files, except those also in other groups.
admin_portfolio_delete_media_description: It's deleted from every group it's in ({count}), files included.
admin_portfolio_description_hint: For the admin only, to know what the group is about.
admin_portfolio_group_removed: The group was taken out of the category.
admin_portfolio_no_existing_groups: Every group is already in this category.
admin_portfolio_no_existing_media: There are no other photos or videos in the portfolio.
admin_portfolio_pick_media: Pick at least one photo or video.
admin_portfolio_remove_group_description: The group stays in its other categories and in the groups list.
admin_portfolio_remove_media_description: It stays in its other groups; if it's in none, it's deleted with its files.
admin_portfolio_uploaded: {count} files were uploaded and are being processed in the background; the table shows them when they're ready.
admin_portfolio_variants_changing: Being reprocessed in the background; the table shows the new variants when it's done.
admin_portfolio_youtube_invalid: That's not a valid YouTube link.
account_albums_empty: You don't have any albums yet. When one is ready, you get an email and find it here.
admin_albums_add_entries_description: New photos, a directory, or a YouTube video with its file. Everything is added at the end.
admin_albums_archive_synced: The zip is up to date
admin_albums_cover_cleared: The cover is now the album's first photo.
admin_albums_delete_description: “{title}” is deleted for good, with all its files and its zip.
admin_albums_delete_directory_descriptio: The directory is deleted with everything in it ({count}), files included.
admin_albums_delete_entry_description: It's deleted for good, with its files.
admin_albums_directory_hint: In the link without accents and with dashes: “Dans și tort” becomes dans-si-tort.
admin_albums_locks_hint: From then the album doesn't open anymore, and on deletion it's gone for good.
admin_albums_move_description: It's moved to the end of the chosen directory.
admin_albums_new_description: The album starts as a draft: only you see it until you publish it.
admin_albums_publish_description: The album shows in the client's account and its link works for everyone. {email} gets an email.
admin_albums_publish_no_email: The album's link works for everyone. It has no client email, so no email is sent.
admin_albums_unpublish_description: The album leaves the client's account and its link stops working, until you publish it again.
admin_albums_unpublished: The album is a draft again.
admin_albums_video_file_hint: For downloading; it plays from YouTube. MP4, MOV or WebM, of any size.
album_link_renewed: The album has a new link.
album_renew_link_description: The current link stops working, also for anyone you sent it to. Files already opened stay reachable until the album is deleted.
admin_albums_archive_busy: The zip is already being made.
admin_albums_archive_changes: {added} new, {removed} removed, {changed} changed since the last zip
